reason: A DSH plugin for bounded, persistent agent and user memory with local storage, memory-management tools, deterministic search, and session-start context injection.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于本地存储的持久化智能体笔记与用户画像管理，并在会话开始时注入记忆快照。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with bounded persistent agent notes and user-profile memory, local memory-management tools, and a session-start snapshot injected into context.

capabilities: Persists agent notes and user-profile entries in local DSH storage
Provides tools to add, replace, remove, batch, search, list, inspect, and measure stored memory
Injects a frozen memory snapshot at the start of each session
Displays stored memory content to the model within the session context
